lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Six hours later, Kestrel and Tern are one hull.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: The seam's sealed. Thrust is up thirty percent, no clamp drag. Kestrel has never flown this clean.

lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: My bunk is now forty metres closer to the coffee. Best day of my life.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Party on the big ship! Sparrow's bringing snacks. The snacks are crackers.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: Look at us. A real fleet.

lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: Captain, can you hear the seam? It hums.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: That's just the coupling settling. Old ships creak, new ships hum.

lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: It's a nice rhythm. Almost like counting.
